steps.title: Step 1 of 9: Choose the workspace
steps.line: Hi! You have one workspace I can use, demo. Shall we start there?

steps.title: Step 2 of 9: Choose the source
steps.line: demo has one source, demo_lh. I picked it for you.

steps.title: Step 3 of 9: Choose the schema
steps.line: demo_lh has one schema with tables, dbo. I picked it for you.

steps.title: Step 4 of 9: The map
steps.line: Here is how your tables connect. Next I count each link in the rows.

steps.title: Step 5 of 9: Check against the rows
steps.line: Let me count each key and link in the rows, so nothing is built on a guess.

steps.title: Step 6 of 9: Your decisions
steps.line: One link needs your decision. The count supports it, and you decide.

steps.title: Step 7 of 9: Doubled totals
steps.line: Where would a total count twice? I show each amount and where it belongs.

steps.title: Step 8 of 9: Dry run
steps.line: Bronze to silver to gold. Try a dry run: nothing is created.

steps.title: Step 8 of 9: Dry run
steps.line: Bronze to silver to gold. Try a dry run: nothing is created.

steps.title: Step 9 of 9: Confirm and create
steps.line: I suggest these names. Confirm them, and then you create each one with its own button.

steps.title: Step 9 of 9: Confirm and create
steps.line: Confirmed. Each button creates one item in Fabric, on a second tap. Nothing is deleted.
